_dev_notes: DEV NOTE: Registry seal live-surface fixture. This file records the registry files that are part of the launch registry bundle surface.
DEV NOTE: schema_version identifies the live-surface schema contract. Changing it is a contract change and must be reviewed deliberately.
DEV NOTE: surface_id and surface_version identify this live-surface record only. They must not define engine behaviour, registry law, release scope, or product authority.
DEV NOTE: seal_scope declares the sealing scope for this surface. registry_bundle means the listed registry entries are treated as the bundle surface for seal checks.
DEV NOTE: entries[] is an explicit closed list of registry paths. Do not replace it with broad filesystem discovery, inferred registry inclusion, or hidden path expansion.
DEV NOTE: Each entry path should remain reviewable because adding or removing a registry file changes what the launch registry seal surface covers.
DEV NOTE: Keep this file strict JSON. Do not add comments, trailing commas, JSONC syntax, or parser-specific extensions.
